name: joltapi
description: A UI-driven REST API client for VS Code — build, send, and inspect HTTP requests without leaving the editor.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Collections, variables, and proxies are read from and written to the workspace as plain JSON and are never executed. Sending a request always requires an explicit user action. In untrusted workspaces, workspace-level overrides of the proxy and default-header settings are ignored — so an untrusted repository's .vscode/settings.json can neither inject extra headers nor seed a proxy profile that would route your requests through an attacker's server.

joltapi.sslVerify.description: Verify SSL certificates. Disable for self-signed certificates.

joltapi.maxRedirects.description: Maximum number of redirects to follow.

joltapi.defaultHeaders.description: Default headers added to every request.

joltapi.proxy.host.markdownDescription: Proxy host imported once per workspace into a saved proxy profile named `Workspace default`. Manage proxies in the JoltAPI sidebar's **Proxies** tab; requests pick one there.

joltapi.proxy.port.markdownDescription: Proxy port for `#joltapi.proxy.host#`. Both must be set for the profile to be imported.

joltapi.proxy.username.markdownDescription: Proxy username for `#joltapi.proxy.host#`. The password is never stored in settings — add it to the profile in the **Proxies** tab.

joltapi.historyLimit.description: Maximum number of history entries to keep.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run clean && npm run compile:production && npm run build:webview
scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run build:webview
scripts.dev: npm run compile && npm run build:webview
scripts.lint: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.src.json && cd webview-ui && npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.test:host: npx tsc -p tsconfig.json && npx mocha --ui tdd out-test/tests/**/*.test.js
scripts.test: npm run test:host && npm run test:webview
